capabilities: Apply preset or custom LLM cleanup actions to a note or selection
Review changes as a per-hunk diff with accept/reject and single-undo apply
Merge and deduplicate multiple meeting notes into one structured note
Generate Mermaid diagrams, Markdown tables, and Map-of-Content scaffolding
Run actions in batch, on a schedule, or per-folder defaults, with snapshot rollback
extras: Freemium: fully free with your own API key or local model; hosted tiers (Free: 20 actions/month, Pro: $5/month via Polar) offer managed models without an API key. Note content is sent to the configured LLM provider when actions run; plugin settings store keys unencrypted in data.json.
problem: Cleaning up, restructuring and merging LLM-generated text edits normally means trusting the AI blindly; Obsidian has no built-in way to review AI rewrites hunk by hunk before they are applied.
